_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: T2 — Invoice generation from approved billable time (UrenRegistratie) and expenses (Receipt/ExpenseClaimEntry). Two new schemas: Invoice (header + billing model + source references + snapshot summary) and InvoiceLine (per-line source-typed cost with snapshot rate, child of Invoice). Five billing models (t_and_m, fixed_fee, milestone, retainer, mixed). All line totals, VAT and invoice roll-ups are declarative (x-openregister-calculations on InvoiceLine, x-openregister-aggregations on Invoice) per ADR-031 — no BillingModelEngine.php / VATCalculationService.php / InvoiceGenerationService.php services. Lifecycle (draft → posted → cancelled) is declarative; cross-schema preconditions (source-id deduplication to prevent double-invoicing, journal balance on post, milestone-completion gate, retainer presence) delegate to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\InvoiceGuard (ADR-031 exception path, fail-closed). Reuses existing schemas — RateCard for rates, UrenRegistratie for time, Receipt for expenses, Project for the customer FK (a customer is a Project.customerId contact reference, never an invented schema), JournalEntry/GLTransaction for GL posting (ADR-022 real ObjectService API only). Posting materialises one balanced JournalEntry via the JournalEntry lifecycle action (Debit 1300 AR, Credit revenue-by-model, Credit 1500 BTW payable). Seed data ships three worked invoices (T&M, fixed-fee, retainer+overage) matching design.md examples. Multi-currency, payment processing, recurring invoicing, milestone revenue recognition and PDF templating are DEFERRED (out of scope per proposal.md / design.md Non-Goals) — see tasks.md.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: A sales invoice drafted from approved billable time (UrenRegistratie) and expenses (Receipt), supporting five billing models (REQ-ITE-001). The header snapshots the customer, billing model, source-id sets and the rate/retainer references used at draft time; per-line cost detail lives in child InvoiceLine rows. Net/VAT/gross roll up declaratively from the lines (x-openregister-aggregations). Posting materialises exactly one balanced JournalEntry (REQ-ITE-005). Rate snapshots are immutable after draft so a later RateCard change never alters a historical invoice (design D2).

invoiceNumber.description: Sequential invoice number unique per administration + fiscal year (REQ-ITE-001).

billingModel.description: Billing model that defines how line items are calculated and grouped (REQ-ITE-001, design D1). Set at draft time, immutable after posting.

customerId.description: FK to the customer contact record (Project.customerId / NC contact). A customer is a Nextcloud contact reference, never an invented schema.

projectId.description: FK to Project.code the invoice is raised against (single-project per invoice in T2).

rateCardId.description: FK to the RateCard applied for T&M / overage rate resolution (null for pure fixed-fee / milestone).

retainerScheduleId.description: FK to the RetainerSchedule applied for retainer / mixed models (null otherwise). Resolved as RateSchedule in this app's register.

timeEntryIds.description: UrenRegistratie ids included in this invoice. Deduplicated against other non-cancelled invoices on draft/post to prevent double-invoicing (REQ-ITE-007, design D9).

expenseIds.description: Receipt ids included in this invoice. Deduplicated against other non-cancelled invoices on draft/post (REQ-ITE-007).

vatRate.description: Default Dutch BTW rate applied where a line does not override it. One of 21, 9, 6, 0 (REQ-ITE-009).

paymentTerms.description: Human-readable payment terms shown on the invoice.

notes.description: Optional free-text note shown on the invoice footer.

lineItemsByModel.description: Audit metadata keyed by source type → {count, costAmount} in cents. For fixed-fee / milestone the time_entry bucket carries the logged-hours count but zero cost (design D5/D6).

glTransactionId.description: FK to the GLTransaction materialised on posting via the JournalEntry it created (REQ-ITE-005). Set by the lifecycle action.

journalEntryId.description: FK to the JournalEntry materialised on posting (REQ-ITE-005).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this invoice belongs to (RBAC + numbering scope).

netAmount.description: net = SUM(InvoiceLine.costAmount) over this invoice's lines, in cents (REQ-ITE-003).

vatAmount.description: vat = SUM(InvoiceLine.lineVatAmount) over this invoice's lines, in cents (REQ-ITE-009).

grossAmount.description: gross = SUM(InvoiceLine.lineGrossAmount) over this invoice's lines, in cents (REQ-ITE-009).

lineCount.description: Number of InvoiceLine rows on this invoice.

lines.description: The cost lines of this invoice (REQ-ITE-002).

rateCard.description: The rate card whose rates were snapshot at draft time (design D2).

project.description: The project this invoice is raised against.

journalEntry.description: The JournalEntry materialised when this invoice was posted (REQ-ITE-005).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Lines, rates and source references may be changed before posting. Source ids are deduplicated against other non-cancelled invoices.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Booked to accounts receivable. Materialised into exactly one balanced JournalEntry (REQ-ITE-005). Immutable — billing model and rate snapshots are frozen.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Superseded draft. Releases its source ids for re-invoicing. A posted invoice is never cancelled — corrections are made by a credit note (T3+).

post.label: Post to AR
post.description: Validate (no duplicate source ids, model-consistent lines, retainer present for retainer/mixed, milestone complete for milestone) then materialise one balanced JournalEntry: Debit 1300 (AR) gross, Credit revenue-by-model net, Credit 1500 (BTW payable) vat (REQ-ITE-005). Gated by the InvoiceGuard cross-schema precondition.

actions.description: Materialise exactly one balanced JournalEntry per REQ-ITE-005; sets journalEntryId / glTransactionId.

cancel.label: Cancel draft
cancel.description: Cancel an un-posted draft, releasing its time/expense source ids for re-invoicing (REQ-ITE-007). Posted invoices cannot be cancelled.

InvoiceLine.title: Invoice Line
InvoiceLine.description: A single cost line on an Invoice, typed by source (time_entry, expense, retainer_charge, fixed_fee, milestone, manual) (REQ-ITE-002). For time lines the applied rate is snapshot into rateApplied so a later RateCard change never re-prices a historical line (design D2). lineNetAmount, lineVatAmount and lineGrossAmount are derived declaratively (x-openregister-calculations) from costAmount × vatRate — no VATCalculationService.php (ADR-031). costAmount is the authoritative net line cost in cents.

lineNumber.description: 1-based position of this line on the invoice.

sourceId.description: FK to the originating record (UrenRegistratie id for time_entry, Receipt id for expense). Null for synthetic lines (retainer_charge / fixed_fee / milestone).

description.description: Human-readable line description, e.g. 'Senior Consultant — 40 hours @ €150/hr'.

billableUnits.description: Hours (time) or count (expense) before markup. Informational; cost is authoritative.

rateApplied.description: Snapshot of the rate used: {rate (cents/unit), currency, rateCardVersion, effectiveDate}. Immutable after draft (design D2). Null for expense / non-rate lines.

markup.description: Markup percentage applied to the raw rate × units (0-100). Default 0 (REQ-ITE-002).

costAmount.description: Final net line cost in cents after rate × units × (1 + markup/100), banker's-rounded to the cent (REQ-ITE-002 / REQ-ITE-009). Authoritative.

vatRate.description: Dutch BTW rate for this line (REQ-ITE-009).

modelSpecificFields.description: {milestoneId, milestoneCompletedAt, milestoneName} for milestone lines; {retainerMonth} for retainer_charge lines; {} otherwise (design D6, REQ-ITE-008).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration (RBAC scope), mirrors the parent invoice.

lineVatAmount.description: Line BTW in cents = round(costAmount × vatRate / 100) (REQ-ITE-009). Declarative per ADR-031 — no VATCalculationService.php.

lineNetAmount.description: Net line amount in cents (alias of costAmount, exposed for invoice-line reporting parity).

lineGrossAmount.description: Gross line amount in cents = costAmount + lineVatAmount (REQ-ITE-009).
